page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2gne.16xlarge is an x86_64 storage-focused cloud server built on the KVM hypervisor. Compute resources are driven by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor providing 64 dedicated virtual cores operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. The server configuration includes 256 GB of system memory, establishing a standard 4 GB per core general-purpose allocation. Network communication is supported by a 20 Gbps baseline bandwidth capacity, facilitating consistent intra-cluster and host data transfers.

Storage capabilities are anchored by an integrated 7679 GB local SSD, providing high-capacity solid-state disk directly tied to the computing instance. The server operates without discrete GPU accelerators, concentrating its silicon envelope entirely on CPU execution, memory throughput, and storage throughput. In terms of resource allocation, bundling substantial local solid-state capacity eliminates the operational latency overhead of network-attached block devices, providing superior qualitative I/O density compared to standard non-storage instance families.

Tradeoffs center around the reliance on local ephemeral SSD storage, which prioritizes throughput and low access latency at the expense of automated persistence abstractions found in external block storage. Consequently, ecs.i2gne.16xlarge is best matched for scale-out workloads with built-in data replication mechanisms. These include distributed NoSQL databases such as Cassandra or MongoDB, large relational database engines, Elasticsearch indexing clusters, Apache Kafka streaming brokers, and intensive batch ETL processing.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2gne.16xlarge is a storage-oriented instance designed for I/O-intensive enterprise workloads. Powered by the x86_64 architecture on the KVM hypervisor, it features 64 dedicated Intel Xeon 8163 vCPUs running at a baseline frequency of 2.5 GHz, paired with 256 GB of system RAM to maintain a balanced 4 GB per core ratio. A central differentiator is its bundled 7679 GB local SSD storage array, which offers high local capacity directly attached to the host, alongside a 20 Gbps baseline network interface. The instance includes no discrete GPU hardware accelerators. By integrating extensive high-speed local disk capacity with substantial compute and memory resources, this instance delivers strong resource density for data operations. It is well matched for high-throughput transactional databases, distributed NoSQL storage clusters, data warehousing, and log analytics pipelines.
